applicability: Processes enqueue into the same queue. A successful enqueue must persist its item, and failures must be observable.
law: Two successful overlapping enqueues preserve both distinct item identities.

input_strategy.actions: Use separate processes, synchronize them before enqueue, and use a gate to force overlapping invocations. Inspect the reopened queue after both finish.

edge_cases: Both operations contend for a read/modify/write transition.

oracle.method: A two-item multiset model based on the successful calls. Either order is legal for two overlapping enqueues.

known_wrong_implementations: Use an in-process lock for separate processes.
Open the persisted queue before acquiring the exclusive lock.
